messages:
sylvie: idea: run a targeted mini-beta for customers with high streaming volume to stress-test fallback + batching logic. small cohort (12) focused on infra edge-cases.
tom: love it. what's the primary success metric? latency p95 under degraded mode?
sylvie: metrics: p95 latency under normal, p95 under simulated capacity loss, and % of sessions that triggered graceful fallback. want at least 90% graceful fallback.
alex: also collect developer pain points: integration friction, error visibility, and onboarding docs clarity.
ops-bot: created ticket INF-312 for simulated capacity loss harness.
sylvie: compensation: $500 credits or equivalent engineering support. invite criteria: >=50k streaming tokens/week historically.
tom: cohort size = 12. acceptance threshold = 60% of qualifiers.
alex: survey flow: pre-run baseline, mid-run quick pulse, post-run deep interview. will need SRE support for synthetic overload tests.
sylvie: schedule invites next Tue. tom: I'll own instrumentation. alex: I'll prepare interview guide. ops-bot: linked tickets to INF-312 and DP-ONBOARD-22. :rocket:
